sentences: Two nondeterministic timed automata specify collections of words whose events carry timing information.
The project asks whether some deterministic timed automaton accepts all words in the first collection while rejecting all words in the second.
The separator may have any finite number of clocks, with no bound supplied beforehand.
The source gives decidability when that clock count is fixed, leaving unbounded separator resources as the main obstacle.
An unrestricted test would characterize when timed behaviors admit a deterministic classifier despite nondeterministic input descriptions.
